The U.S. and Europe may have different views on renewable energy, but they are increasingly aligned on reducing China’s role in their power grids. At the center of this battle is a small device called a power inverter.

A Sungrow inverter. Credit: Sungrow

Once an offline tool used to translate renewable power into usable electricity, the inverter has evolved into a smart gatekeeper of grid systems.
